decisive_items: compression of the third portion of the duodenum between the superior mesenteric artery and the aorta at an acute angle
A previously healthy young man presented during a month of religious fasting
He had been compliant with fasting customs, was markedly lean
response.rationale: Both candidates share the definitive high-specificity CT finding of superior mesenteric artery compression of the third duodenum, so that shared span is not double-counted. C1 additionally uses the raw fasting and markedly lean context to supply the precipitating cause/temporal axis, making the composite diagnosis more complete. R1 is correct but gives only the syndrome label without contextual cause support. Normal endoscopy further excludes an intrinsic luminal lesion, but does not separate the two candidates.
